customer_not_found.label: Customer not found
customer_not_found.explanationText: I cannot find the customer for Order #1234.

explanationBullets.text: Sending an audio signal to the customer

customer_not_found.failDescription: I cannot detect any customer with Order #1234 near the checkout area. I will trigger a PA announcement in 30 seconds.

alert.caption: I cannot detect the customer near the checkout area
alert.detail: I cannot identify the target customer with my camera. I will send an audio signal in 30 seconds to attract attention.

validation.prompt: Does this image show the checkout area with no matching customer?

robotParams.suggestion: Check whether the customer has moved away from the checkout area and confirm the camera lens is clean.

item_not_found.label: Item not on shelf
item_not_found.explanationText: I cannot find the requested item for Order #1587 on the expected shelf.

explanationBullets.text: Item not found at expected location

item_not_found.failDescription: I cannot find the item at shelf B-12. Scanning nearby shelves…

alert.caption: I cannot find the requested item on shelf B-12
alert.detail: My camera confirms the shelf slot is empty. I am now scanning adjacent shelves in Aisle 4 for a possible misplacement.

validation.prompt: Does this image confirm the shelf slot at B-12 is empty?

robotParams.suggestion: Verify the shelf label at B-12 and check whether the item was relocated to a neighbouring slot.

path_blocked.label: Path obstructed
path_blocked.explanationText: My planned route to checkout for Order #1802 is blocked by an obstacle.
path_blocked.failDescription: I detected a pallet blocking Aisle 3. Recalculating route…

alert.caption: I detected an obstacle — a pallet blocking Aisle 3
alert.detail: I detected an unexpected pallet at coordinates (12, 7) with my depth sensor. I am calculating an alternative route via Aisle 5.

validation.prompt: Does this image show an obstacle blocking Aisle 3?

robotParams.suggestion: Remove or move the pallet from Aisle 3 to allow the robot to resume its planned route.

grip_failure.label: Grip failure
grip_failure.explanationText: I could not secure the item for Order #2045 with my gripper. Retrying.
grip_failure.failDescription: Grip check failed — item slipped during pickup. Retrying with adjusted angle.

alert.caption: I lost grip — the item slipped during pickup
alert.detail: My force sensor detected the item slipping at 78% grip pressure. I am repositioning to attempt pickup at a 15° offset angle.

validation.prompt: Does this image show the item slipping from the gripper?

robotParams.suggestion: Inspect the gripper pads for wear and confirm the item is positioned upright on the shelf.
All systems nominal — no action required.

pipeline.title: Pouring
pipeline.description: I lost tracking of the glass during pouring

pipeline.title: Standing by
pipeline.description: I am waiting for the customer to place a glass

glass_lost.explanationText: I lost track of the glass — it may have been removed or occluded.

explanationBullets.text: Waiting for a new glass placement

glass_lost.failDescription: I lost track of the glass — it may have been removed or occluded.

alert.caption: I can no longer detect the glass on the table
alert.detail: I lost tracking of the glass at the pour position. It may have been moved or occluded. I have halted pouring for safety.

validation.prompt: Does this image confirm the glass is no longer at the pouring position?

robotParams.suggestion: Wipe the camera lens and ensure the glass is placed flat on the table without any object on top of it.
